summary: scripts/evidence-log keeps a copy of every trusted evidence record on a host we hold and a signed, append-only log of them (one file per tree and per input key, a signed heartbeat commit every pull), published to refs/evidence-log/main; it reports and can restore logged records the remote lost, and takes GC lines before GC deletes. scripts/evidence-log.timer runs it every 2 minutes as a systemd user unit.

replay.detail: A new operator script and its unit files; no record, signature or verifier rule changes.

schema.detail: New ref refs/evidence-log/main: a chain of commits signed by the log key whose tree holds trees/<tree[:2]>/<tree> and keys/<check>/<key[:2]>/<key> files of 'record <record> <check> <exit_code> <signer> <observed_at>' and 'gc <time> <plan sha256>' lines.

rules.detail: No verifier reads the log yet; a later change adds the rule, in shadow first.

compatibility.detail: Outside refs/heads and refs/tags: clones and workflow checkouts do not fetch it.

manual.detail: To run it: copy scripts/evidence-log-timer to ~/.local/bin and the .service and .timer to ~/.config/systemd/user, write ~/.config/evidence-log/signer.json and log-keys, then systemctl --user enable --now evidence-log.timer.

recovery.detail: Disable the timer; the ref can be deleted, nothing depends on it yet.
